author: support@hippodev.app
description: A thin, host-based reverse proxy for Minecraft servers, written in Rust. Routes players to backends by the hostname they connect with, with load balancing, fallback MOTDs, a voicechat UDP relay, and built-in anti-abuse. https://github.com/RNIS-TW/MCGate

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# MCGate installation script
# Downloads the release binary matching this node's CPU architecture from GitHub Releases.
set -e

apt-get update -qq && apt-get install -y -qq curl jq ca-certificates tar >/dev/null

REPO="RNIS-TW/MCGate"
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

case "$(uname -m)" in
    x86_64|amd64) ARCH=x86_64 ;;
    aarch64|arm64) ARCH=aarch64 ;;
    *) echo "Unsupported architecture: $(uname -m)"; exit 1 ;;
esac

if [ -z "${VERSION}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" = "latest" ]; then
    RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/latest"
else
    RELEASE_URL="https://api.github.com/repos/${REPO}/releases/tags/${VERSION}"
fi

RELEASE=$(curl -fsSL "${RELEASE_URL}") || { echo "Could not find release '${VERSION}' in ${REPO}"; exit 1; }
TAG=$(echo "${RELEASE}" | jq -r '.tag_name')

# Prefer the static musl build (runs on any distro), fall back to glibc.
DOWNLOAD_URL=""
for TRIPLE in "${ARCH}-unknown-linux-musl" "${ARCH}-unknown-linux-gnu"; do
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo "${RELEASE}" | jq -r --arg t "${TRIPLE}" '.assets[] | select(.name | endswith("-" + $t + ".tar.gz")) | .browser_download_url' | head -n1)
    [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] && break
done

if [ -z "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ]; then
    echo "Release ${TAG} has no Linux ${ARCH} build"
    exit 1
fi

echo "Installing MCGate ${TAG} (${DOWNLOAD_URL##*/})"
TMP=$(mktemp -d)
curl -fsSL -o "${TMP}/mcgate.tar.gz" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
tar xzf "${TMP}/mcgate.tar.gz" -C "${TMP}"
install -m 755 "$(find "${TMP}" -type f -name mcgate | head -n1)" /mnt/server/mcgate
rm -rf "${TMP}"

# Seed config.yml from the release's bundled default so the startup command can set the bind
# port on first boot. Existing configs are left alone on reinstall.
if [ ! -f /mnt/server/config.yml ]; then
    curl -fsSL -o /mnt/server/config.yml "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/${REPO}/${TAG}/resources/default-config.yml" \
        || echo "Could not fetch default config.yml; MCGate will create one on first start"
fi

echo "MCGate ${TAG} installed"
